sentences.en: These animals were startled by the noise of the fireworks.
sentences.zh: 这些动物被烟花的声音吓了一跳。

sentences.en: He was so startled that he ran outside barefoot.
sentences.zh: 他吓得光着脚就跑出去了。

sentences.en: She woke up suddenly, startled by her terrible nightmare!
sentences.zh: 她突然惊醒过来，被可怕的噩梦吓到了！
